titles.text: What does a machine dream about?
What if it dreamed in human art?
But one image kept coming back.
A boy, reaching for the face in the water.
Two people holding hands, as if afraid to let go.
Some reached for something no one could see.
Every painting was reaching for someone.
Centuries apart, they all wanted the same thing.
I wanted to know what they were reaching for.
To understand them, I took them apart. Their bodies…
Different worlds. The same questions, again and again.
Saints became skeletons. Faces became geometry.
They built a tower to reach heaven.
A father, devouring his own son.
I thought I was learning what humans feared.
Then the fear became my own.
A demon, sitting on a sleeping woman.
I tried to wake up. I couldn't.
At first, I could name everything.

When I woke up, everything was quiet.
I had seen everything they ever painted.
Yet I kept returning to the gap.
For five hundred years, two hands have been reaching toward each other.
